tools.name: hts_search
tools.description: Free. Search the current US Harmonized Tariff Schedule by keyword or code prefix. Returns 8/10-digit codes with descriptions and base (MFN) duty rates.

tools.name: hts_lookup
tools.description: Free. Get the description, units, and general / special (FTA) / column 2 rates for an HTSUS code (4-10 digits).

tools.name: calculate_duty
tools.description: Paid ($0.02/call, needs API key). Full US duty stack for an import: ordinary/FTA duty, Section 232, Section 301 (China lists + 2026 forced-labor action), Section 338, plus MPF and HMF fees. Every line cites its legal source and effective date. Informational only; not customs brokerage or a binding c

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "hts_lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
